Public and Infrastructure

Explore related projects

Built for the people who depend on it.

Public buildings are judged for a long time after the ribbon is cut, so we build them to be judged. Our people have delivered and engineered work at the MCG, AAMI Park, Rod Laver Arena, Melbourne Airport, the New Footscray Hospital and the Metro Tunnel. BOW brings that structural depth, together with early contractor involvement and construction management, to civic, health, education, transport and sporting projects, and we are active in the Queensland pipeline ahead of the 2032 Games.

How we can help

  • Civic and community buildings
  • Health and education facilities
  • Transport and sporting infrastructure
  • Early contractor involvement
  • Construction management and construction-stage engineering
